snippet.title: HELLEVATOR — KILL. THEM. ALL. | Official Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist HELLEVATOR on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5531630/HELLEVATOR/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer71

A freight elevator descends the hundreds of floors of hell. Every time it stops, the doors open and demons pile in. KILL. THEM. ALL.

Four heroes: The Samurai, The Crone, The Fallen, The Last Marine. Six strings each, four specials, two ultimates. Fighting-game motions (236, 41236), all buffered. A boss every fifth floor. Satan at the bottom.

A wishlist is the biggest thing you can do for a game like this: Steam shows it to more people, and you get an email the day it launches.

Free demo on Steam, or play it in your browser right now: https://hellevator.online
Every link: https://hellevator.online/links

X: https://x.com/hellevatorop
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/hellevator.online

By The Operator.
